verdict.rationale: Bitwarden ships an official, documented `bw` CLI described as a fully-featured vault tool. A runtime probe confirmed it installs from npm (@bitwarden/cli) and runs, and its `bw serve` mode exposes the vault as a local REST API. Personal API key authentication supports automated workflows, and the CLI docs have an LLM-friendly .md mirror; a community hands-on report (`bw list` printing secrets in plaintext) is a usability caveat, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of agent-oriented guidance or structured-output conventions for AI workflows, and no independent corroboration of safe, scoped output for agents.
